{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2021–22 |team=Santa Clara Broncos |sport=Basketball |image=Santa Clara Broncos logo.svg |conference=West Coast Conference |division= |short_conf= WCC |APRank= |CoachRank= |record= 21–12 |conf_record= 10–5 |head_coach=[[Herb Sendek]] |hc_year = 6th |asst_coach1=Jason Ludwig |asst_coach2=[[Scott Garson]] |asst_coach3=Ryan Madry |stadium=[[Leavey Center]] |champion= |tourney=[[2022 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |tourney_result=First Round }} {{2021–22 West Coast Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball team''' represented [[Santa Clara University]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Broncos were led by sixth-year head coach [[Herb Sendek]] and played their home games at the [[Leavey Center]] as members of the [[West Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 21–12, 10–5 in WCC play to finish in third place. They defeated [[2021–22 Portland Pilots men's basketball team|Portland]] in the third round of the [[2022 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2021–22 Saint Mary's Gaels men's basketball team|Saint Mary's]]. They received an invitation to the [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]], where they lost in the first round to [[2021–22 Washington State Cougars men's basketball team|Washington State]]. ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Santa Clara Broncos men's basketball team|Broncos]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 12–8, 4–5 in WCC play to finish in sixth place. They defeated [[2020–21 Portland Pilots men's basketball team|Portland]] and [[2020–21 Pacific Tigers men's basketball team|Pacific]] in the [[2021 West Coast Conference men's basketball tournament|WCC tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2020–21 Pepperdine Waves men's basketball team|Pepperdine]]. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
